If the ray hits a node but not a leaf, decrease the level (move to a finer octant) and continue [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that if a ray hits a node but not a leaf, the level should be decreased (moved to a finer octant) and the process continued. Source [S1] explicitly describes the traversal logic: 'Nachfolgend werden... der Index und die Position des aktuellen Eltern-Knotens zwischengespeichert und schließlich die currentDepthVariable inkrementiert, der Baum also eine Ebene tiefer traversiert.' (Subsequently, the index and position of the current parent node are saved and finally the currentDepthVariable is incremented, so the tree is traversed one level deeper). In the context of an Octree, traversing 'deeper' means moving from a parent node to its children, which corresponds to moving to a finer (smaller) octant. This matches the claim's instruction to 'move to a finer octant' when not at a leaf.
